description: Route a design requirement to parts: give a subcategory (e.g. joint-actuators, strain-wave-reducers, frameless-bldc) and the numbers the design needs, and get every part ranked against them. Each result says, per requirement, whether it meets, is close (within 15%), misses, or is unknown, and the response names the requirement blocking the most options and how far to relax it. Call requirement_keys first to see which keys a subcategory accepts.

priorities.description: Requirement keys that count double in the fit score

any.description: For text keys such as interface: matches if any token is present, e.g. ["CAN","EtherCAT"]

key.description: Spec key from requirement_keys, e.g. peak_torque_nm, mass_g, voltage_v, interface, price_usd, torque_density

name: match_requirements

error.description: Set when the tool could not answer; the other fields are then absent.

title: Match parts to requirements
